_help: Every talent: name, category (ancestry | archetype | aspect | static), group (the ancestry, archetype, god or spell group), uses, cost, prerequisites, effect. Prerequisites: separate several with commas. Talent names (e.g. 'Shadow stalker'), skills ('Lore +3' or 'lore 3+') and ancestries ('Orvosa ancestry') are checked automatically, anything else is shown as a note.

categories.name: Ancestry talents
categories.description: Talents every character of an ancestry starts with, plus ancestry-specific options. They don't count towards your talent picks.

categories.name: Talents by archetype
categories.description: The main pool of talents, sorted by archetype. Archetypes are only a guide – you can freely mix talents from different archetypes.

categories.name: Aspect talents
categories.description: Talents granted by the aspects of the gods.

categories.name: Static spells
categories.description: Fixed spells with defined effects. A normal character can take up to 3 static spells as regular talents.

talents.name: Skilled
talents.effect: During rest you may increase a skill by 1 and decrease another by 1 until you rest again.

talents.name: Versatile
talents.effect: Choose any talent that you fulfill the prerequisites for.

talents.name: Darkvision
talents.effect: You have black and white darkvision.

talents.name: Rock eater
talents.effect: You are able to eat rocks to gain special traits based on the rock you consumed. You can have 3 of these traits active at the same time, eating more rocks replaces the oldest trait.

talents.name: Image of Orvos
talents.effect: Whenever you interact with another person choose one of the following boons for your interaction: intimidation | persuasion | seduction | deception

talents.name: Gift of Inferna
talents.effect: Choose a creature and an emotion. The creature feels the emotion for as long as you look at it.

talents.name: Essence Magic
talents.effect: Create a static spell from the essence element. You can cast this spell innately.

talents.name: Rapid Evolution
talents.effect: Choose one of the following talents from below:

talents.name: Feral
talents.effect: You gain natural weapons on your hands and feet. Gain +1 die when attacking with them.

talents.name: Verdant
talents.effect: You have the ability to photosynthesize. Being in direct sunlight for a time heals a lvl1 wound.

talents.name: Urban
talents.effect: You gain the ability to squeeze through tiny cracks and holes.

talents.name: Deep
talents.effect: You gain a simple form of echolocation, allowing you to navigate in complete darkness by screaming.

talents.name: Resilience
talents.effect: You are resistant against the cold, ice and freezing etc. Conflict you gain from such sources is always reduced to -conflict.

talents.name: Adrenaline rush
talents.effect: When you enter a fight gain +1 resolve which you can use it during the fight. If you do not use it, it disappears after the fight is over.

talents.name: Limit Breaker
talents.effect: Gain +1 boon on any physical check you make. If you use this talent the next check you make, has +1 flaw.

talents.name: Regeneration
talents.effect: When you rest you may reduce a lvl 2 wound to a lvl 1 wound instead of removing a lvl 1 wound.

talents.name: Gob's Honor
talents.effect: You have an honor codex. Note down 5 tenets that represent you and which you must follow to become your true self. Whenever you act accordingly to your tenets, you gain +1 charge. Other talents can use these charges for special effects.

talents.name: Gob's Nature
talents.effect: You are bound to your liege by an oath. Whenever you roll any check you may reroll 2 dice. You do not gain back charges by resting, but instead you must fulfill a quest for your liege to restore all charges of this talent.

talents.name: Hivemind
talents.effect: You can speak telepathically to other intelligent creatures. If you are in the vicinity of other quabut you can read their minds and they can read yours.

talents.name: Living Spores
talents.effect: You can detach a patch of harmless? spores from your body to either infect another creature with or leave them on a surface. You can sense the spores and if you infected a creature with them, they will continue growing until they remove them completely or you infect another creature with the spores.

talents.name: Dead body
talents.effect: Ignore lvl 1 wounds.

talents.name: Never really dead
talents.effect: When you die, you may resurrect yourself. This process takes a few days and you will gain a trait based on your death.

talents.name: Thoughts for food
talents.effect: You can consume recently deceased creatures to gain insight into their thoughts before death. The fresher the creature, the longer back the memories go.

talents.name: Riftmaker
talents.effect: You can gain a lvl 2 wound to create a temporary rift in reality towards another reality. You can not enter this rift, but you may try to grab an item from the other side.

talents.name: Scrying ear
talents.effect: Choose an item. You can listen through the item until you rest.

talents.name: Scrying eye
talents.effect: Choose an item. You can see through the item until you rest.

talents.name: Macguffin
talents.effect: Choose an item to track and always know the position of. Lasts until you choose another item.

talents.name: Quick forgery
talents.effect: Falsify a paper or document in a short amount of time, but it will fall apart after an hour

talents.name: Secret message
talents.effect: You can choose to write in invisible ink.

talents.name: Winged informant
talents.effect: Receive a useful piece of information from a bird that carries a letter.

talents.name: Honest exchange
talents.effect: You gain a truthful answer for one of your questions, but in turn you must answer one of theirs truthfully

talents.name: Status sense
talents.effect: You can sense the person of highest status or authority in any situation.

talents.name: Flashback scene
talents.effect: When you make a roll in a situation, you can instead explain how you have prepared for exactly this situation and treat the roll as a success.

talents.name: Mutationist
talents.effect: Create injectable mutagens that give passive bonuses.

talents.name: Brewer
talents.effect: Create potions and drinks

talents.name: Portable cauldron
talents.effect: Summon a cauldron to brew in

talents.name: Bomber
talents.effect: Create Bombs and explosives

talents.name: Favorite recipe
talents.effect: Learn a crafting recipe by heart so you do not have to make a crafting check for it.

talents.name: Reactive resistance
talents.effect: Gain resistance against the last element that caused you harm

talents.name: Backstab
talents.effect: Gain +effect when attacking or damaging an unsuspecting creature.

talents.name: Translucency
talents.effect: Stand completely still to become translucent until you move again.

talents.name: Shadow stalker
talents.effect: Gain +1 boon to trickery checks while you are within shadows.

talents.name: Shadow jumper
talents.effect: Teleport from shadow to shadow

talents.name: Living shadow
talents.effect: Meld with shadows to become invisible while completely within shadows.

talents.name: Shadowmaster
talents.effect: You can attack a persons shadow to attack their physical form.

talents.name: Nonterminal velocity
talents.effect: You take no damage from a fall as long as you can move and act freely.

talents.name: Wall runner
talents.effect: Run along walls as if they were the ground for a time.

talents.name: Ok, anyway...
talents.effect: Change the topic of any conversation without the other people in the conversation noticing.

talents.name: Death glare
talents.effect: A single stare is enough to unsettle creatures. Add knocking them out | killing them to the possible effects.

talents.name: Ventriloquist
talents.effect: You can make your sound originate from other locations around you.

talents.name: Inspire
talents.effect: When you inspire an ally, you can spend a charge of this talent to instead give a boon to all allies near you.

talents.name: Lullaby
talents.effect: Roll an influence check to make people fall asleep

talents.name: Unnamed talent
talents.effect: Tell a joke to make people laugh uncontrollably

talents.name: Fueled fighting
talents.effect: When you take damage in a fight, gain +1 boon that stacks for all combat checks for the remainder of the fight

talents.name: Adrenaline rush
talents.effect: Spend 1 resolve to prevent 1 lvl1 | lvl2 wound.

talents.name: Revenge
talents.effect: Whenever you kill an enemy heal the last wound they inflicted on you.

talents.name: Giant grappler
talents.effect: You can grapple and hold creatures that are much larger than you.

talents.name: Living weapon
talents.effect: You can grapple a creature and still continue fighting as if you had two hands free. You can choose to use the grappled creature as a weapon. In that case make skirmish checks with -1 success.

talents.name: Reckless attack
talents.effect: Gain +1 lvl1 wound to reroll all fails on your next combat check

talents.name: I like those odds
talents.effect: As long as you are outnumbered you gain a number of boons for skirmish checks based on the difference of enemies and allies

talents.name: Bloodbath
talents.effect: Bathe in the blood of a slain creature to gain a temporary boon based on the creature. It lasts until you rest.

talents.name: Delay fate
talents.effect: You can choose to ignore conflict from a check. The GM can add +conflict to any one check you make in the future.

talents.name: Offering
talents.effect: Sacrifice an offering to gain a reroll of all dice for a check.

talents.name: Cleanse
talents.effect: Roll an insight check to remove a negative effect from a creature, but gain it yourself on conflict.

talents.name: Guidance
talents.effect: Ask your god to support you directly. Your situation is treated as unsafe (1) for one action.

talents.name: Apotheosis
talents.effect: Lose this talent and gain a permanent passive effect based on your god or ambition.

talents.name: Strategize
talents.effect: Make 3 insight or lore checks when you wake up. During the day you can choose to use one of those results in place of another check you make.

talents.name: Command
talents.effect: Give a command to an ally. If they try to follow it with their next action, they reroll all 1s on their check.

talents.name: Commanders Aura
talents.effect: Choose one stance when taking this talent: social, combat, travel. All allies beside you gain +1 boon on checks for the chosen stance.

talents.name: Tactical Focus
talents.effect: Mark a creature. Allies that focus that creature with spells or abilities gain +1 boon for all checks against that creature.

talents.name: Show how its done
talents.effect: When you are helping an ally improve their situation, you do not worsen you own.

talents.name: Animal companion
talents.effect: Gain a small companion

talents.name: Animal companion+
talents.effect: Gain a medium companion

talents.name: Animal companion++
talents.effect: Gain a large companion / steed

talents.name: We are one
talents.effect: See through your companions eyes and feel what they feel. As long as you stay in your companion, your body stays behind unconscious.

talents.name: Magical companion
talents.effect: You can cast spells from your compaions position.

talents.name: Swarm
talents.effect: You control a swarm of small insects or critters instead of a single creature.

talents.name: First Aid
talents.effect: When a character reduces a wound during rest after your treatment, they can instead reduce a lvl 2 wound by 1.

talents.name: Advanced Aid
talents.effect: Roll a crafting | lore check to remove 1 lvl1 wound from a creature.

talents.name: Field medicine
talents.effect: Roll a crafting | lore check to reduce a lvl 1 or lvl 2 wound by 1.

talents.name: House's Edge
talents.effect: You can choose a single die in any check made by anyone and determine which side it lands on.

talents.name: Double down
talents.effect: You can reroll 1 success in a check. If the new roll of that die is also a success, gain +effect

talents.name: Counting dice
talents.effect: Track every 1 you roll during your checks. You can choose to trade them in once during your day for +effect for each 1 you have stored.

talents.name: All in
talents.effect: Bet something special to you on a single roll. On a full success, gain ++Effect but on all other results lose the thing.

talents.name: Snake eyes
talents.effect: When you roll doubles on a check, add another dice to the check.

talents.name: Lucky roll
talents.effect: Instead of rolling a normal check for an action, throw a coin. Heads counts as a green result, while tails counts as a red result.

talents.name: Unnamed talent
talents.effect: You can harvest special ingredients and items from slain creatures.

talents.name: Animal sense
talents.effect: You sense animals in the vicinity.

talents.name: Dangerzone
talents.effect: Concentrate on a creature to see their weak points or injuries.

talents.name: Heatvision
talents.effect: You can see creatures based on their body heat.

talents.name: Dangersense
talents.effect: You can concentrate to sense danger around you. You also gain insight into potential danger in the near future.

talents.name: Tracking mark
talents.effect: You can mark a creature. It leaves a magical trail behind that only you can see. Once you mark another creature, the first one becomes unmarked.

talents.name: Lick a trail
talents.effect: Taste a drop of blood to gain insight about the creature it came from.

talents.name: Quick trap
talents.effect: Create a small trap from whatever materials are close by.

talents.name: First sighting
talents.effect: After encountering a creature make an isnight | lore check to gain knowledge about the creature.

talents.name: Weatherman
talents.effect: Predict the weather for the day.

talents.name: Magical resistance
talents.effect: When you make a check against magical effects, gain +1 die

talents.name: Arcane affinity
talents.effect: When you witness a magical effect you gain some knowledge of the specifics of the spell.

talents.name: Arcane sense
talents.effect: Feel magic around you at all times.

talents.name: Arcane sight
talents.effect: See traces of magic in the vicinity for a short time.

talents.name: Spellbreak
talents.effect: Disrupt a spell?

talents.name: Get down!
talents.effect: You can choose to become the target of an attack or spell when it targets an ally beside you

talents.name: Follow me!
talents.effect: Charge into a fight to give your allies +1 boon during the fight

talents.name: Challenge
talents.effect: Challenge an enemy to come at you and focus their attacks on you.

talents.name: Duel of fate
talents.effect: Challenge an enemy to a 1vs1 fight. The fight lasts until one of you goes down or dies.

talents.name: Unnamed talent
talents.effect: When an ally is knocked out or dies, you gain +1 success on all checks until the threat is neutralized.

talents.name: Shielding aura
talents.effect: Allies besides you gain resistance to harmful effects for a duration. Any check they make against those effects gains +1 boon and they gain -conflict while besides you.

talents.name: Shared pain
talents.effect: When an ally gains a wound, you can allow them to gain a lower level wound, but you gain the same wound.

talents.name: Golden eyes
talents.effect: Sense gold around you, but gain clouded vision for the duration

talents.name: It's all a question of price
talents.effect: You can buy a temporary boon for a check with X gold.

talents.name: Parley
talents.effect: You can establish a neutral reason for you and a hostile creature to talk with one another once per creature.

talents.name: Compulsive liar
talents.effect: Whenever you successfully lie, gain +1 stacking boon on influence checks. The boons reset, when you tell the truth

talents.name: Bribery
talents.effect: You can use money in place of charisma. Every X gold you spend on an influence check adds +1 boon on the check.

talents.name: Relations
talents.effect: When you gain this talent choose a group or type of people. You innately have their respect.

talents.name: Diplomatic immunity
talents.effect: When someone accuses you of something or gives you blame, you gain +1 success on the influence check to reject the blame.

talents.name: Deflect Blame
talents.effect: Instead of rejecting the blame with your dimplomatic immunity, pin the blame to the accuser with your check.

talents.name: Empty promises
talents.effect: You have an ear for lies and can see through them. Whenever you make an insight check to check if someone lies to you, you may reroll all odd results once.

talents.name: Charity
talents.effect: Roll an influence check to gain X gold from your followers.

talents.name: Demilitarized zone
talents.effect: A small area you designate becomes a neutral ground for a while and no lies can be spoken inside the area.

talents.name: Binding contract
talents.effect: You can create an arrangement or contract with another party. Both you and the other party are bound by the contract. If either of you breaks the contract you gain a random curse?

talents.name: Hey you!
talents.effect: You summon a child to your side. Pay however much you see fit and give the child a job to carry out. Based on the payment, the child will carry out more difficult jobs or carry out easier jobs more diligently or faster.

talents.name: I speak for the king
talents.effect: Invoke the status of your superior and speak as if they were talking directly.

talents.name: Instigator
talents.effect: When you interact with a group of people you can find a thing that will lead to conflict between them. Works only once per interaction.

talents.name: The art of the deal
talents.effect: You can retroactively alter the details of a deal or contract you have made, as long as the nature of the deal does not change. Works only once per deal and your relationship to the other party gets worse.

talents.name: Curved shots
talents.effect: You can curve shots with ranged weapons around creatures or walls.

talents.name: Railgun
talents.effect: You can fire your weapons twice as far.

talents.name: Piercing shots
talents.effect: Your next projectile fires through up to 2 enemies.

talents.name: Splitting arrows
talents.effect: Fire into an area instead of a single target.

talents.name: Charged shot
talents.effect: When you make a ranged attack, you can charge it up for 1 action to release an even more powerful shot with your next action.

talents.name: Analyzer
talents.effect: Analyze a creature to gain a boon for all checks relating to the creature

talents.name: Obtuse
talents.effect: Your mind can not be read

talents.name: Dreamwalker
talents.effect: Enter a creatures mind while it is asleep

talents.name: Mindreader
talents.effect: Enter a creatures mind while it is awake

talents.name: Experienced pallette
talents.effect: Gain bonus effects from ingesting potions, food and drink etc.

talents.name: Strongwilled
talents.effect: Become better against magical effects

talents.name: First hand experience
talents.effect: Learn the specifics of a spell when hit by it

talents.name: Voodoo dolls
talents.effect: Craft a doll containing a piece of a creature or person. The creature or person receives a lesser version of anything you do to the puppet. Breaks after two uses.

talents.name: Spectral hand
talents.effect: Summon a spectral hand

talents.name: Permanent spectral hand
talents.effect: Gain a permanent spectral hand

talents.name: Firespeaker
talents.prerequisites: Orvosa Ancestry or an Orvosa teacher
talents.effect: Look into a fire and make an insight check. You may ask a question about the future. Based on effect they are more or less clouded.

talents.name: Beastspeaker
talents.effect: You can speak with animals.

talents.name: Plantspeaker
talents.effect: You can speak with plants.

talents.name: Poison resistance
talents.effect: You are resistant to poison, reduce any wound or negative effect you take from poison by 1.

talents.name: Poison immunity
talents.effect: You are immune to wounds or negative effects from poison.

talents.name: Shapeshift
talents.effect: Transform into a small creature.

talents.name: Shapeshift+
talents.effect: Transform into a medium creature.

talents.name: Shapeshift++
talents.effect: Transform into a large creature.

talents.name: Shapeshift+++
talents.effect: Transform into a giant creature.

talents.name: Genestealer
talents.effect: Copy another persons face.

talents.name: Copycat
talents.effect: Copy another persons clothes and style

talents.name: Parrots voice
talents.effect: Mimic any sound or voice

talents.name: Hamster cheeks
talents.effect: Store up to 4 items in you mouth

talents.name: Temporary wings
talents.effect: Gain wings to fly for a time

talents.name: Spider legs
talents.effect: Stick to walls and ceilings

talents.name: Cat eyes
talents.effect: Gain the ability to see in the dark

talents.name: Dog nose
talents.effect: Gain the ability to use your sense of smell

talents.name: Spell arsenal
talents.effect: You gain the ability to learn any number of static spells and can prepare 3 of them for each day. You also gain 2 static spells with this talent.

talents.name: Spell preparation
talents.effect: You can prepare 5 spells per day

talents.name: Spell switch
talents.effect: You can quickly switch your prepared spells to others from within your arsenal

talents.name: Static energy
talents.effect: The first 5 static spells you cast each day do not cost any threads.

talents.name: Klopf Klopf
talents.effect: Create a passage/portal through a door without opening it

talents.name: Loot goblin
talents.effect: Whenever you loot something valuable, note down +1 die. When you make any check you may use one or more of those dice in the check, using them up.

talents.name: Handy pockets
talents.effect: You can choose a small item to always have available in your hands, even when they are full

talents.name: Chosen weapon
talents.effect: Gain +1 boon as long as you use the chosen weapon

talents.name: Bound weapon
talents.effect: Bind a weapon to you. You can summon it into your hand.

talents.name: Ultra heavy weapons
talents.effect: You can parry weapons and attacks that are significantly larger than your wepaon would allow

talents.name: Arcane Weaving
talents.effect: You gain access to an arcane element of your choice and the ability to weave spells.

talents.name: Element specialization
talents.effect: Choose one specialization of one of the elements you can access. Whenever you cast a spell with the chosen specialization, you gain +1 die.

talents.name: Secondary Element
talents.effect: Gain access to a secondary element adjacent to one of your other elements. When you cast spells from this element your position is more risky.

talents.name: Tertiary Element
talents.effect: Gain access to a tertiary element adjacent to one of your other elements. When you cast spells from this element your position is more risky.

talents.name: Overclocked
talents.effect: Permanently spend 3 threads. All of your spell checks are made with 2d8 + dice bought with spent threads.

talents.name: Arcane Studies
talents.effect: Gain half your lore as additional arcane threads (rounded down).

talents.name: Aspect of Honor
talents.effect: Conflict from fear or terror does not affect you

talents.name: Aspect of Freedom
talents.effect: Wildlife does not see you as a threat until proven otherwise

talents.name: Aspect of Hope
talents.effect: You can create a small globe of light around you

talents.name: Aspect of Peace
talents.effect: You do not need to sleep to rest while you are under moonlight.

talents.name: Aspect of War
talents.effect: After you kill an enemy gain +1 success to the next check you make to kill someone.

talents.name: Aspect of Flame
talents.effect: By looking into a fire you can see visions of the past.

talents.name: Aspect of Corruption
talents.effect: Communicate thoughts with crows, crows are friendly towards you.

talents.name: Aspect of Creation
talents.effect: Touch a stone surface to gain a brief vision of the surroundings.

talents.name: Aspect of Change
talents.effect: Change a feature on you for the day

talents.name: Aspect of Memory
talents.effect: Touch a creature to gain access to one of their memories

talents.name: Aspect of Lies
talents.effect: Lying to someone always results in -conflict

talents.name: Aspect of Wisdom
talents.effect: Read books 5 times as fast

talents.name: Aspect of Justice
talents.effect: Touch a person to learn their most recent crime

talents.name: Aspect of Community
talents.effect: People are more friendly towards you

talents.name: Aspect of Beauty
talents.effect: Create a patch of flowers on any surface

talents.name: Aspect of Sorrow
talents.effect: You can touch a dead creature to briefly speak with it

talents.name: Aspect of Rebirth
talents.effect: Undead do not instinctually attack you

talents.name: Aspect of Balance
talents.effect: Sense the veil between life and death and where it is thinner

talents.name: Warp step
talents.effect: Teleport a short distance

talents.name: Echo
talents.effect: Jumb back a few seconds in time

talents.name: Scry
talents.effect: Create a magical eye on an item to see though

talents.name: Deja Vu
talents.effect: Make a creature repeat the last few seconds

talents.name: Imbue Weapon
talents.effect: Imbue a weapon with an element

talents.name: Poison claws
talents.effect: You coat your natural weapons or fists with a poison.

talents.name: Sign of the sea
talents.effect: Breathe underwater

talents.name: Sign of the ram
talents.effect: Create a shockwave

talents.name: Sign of the mirage
talents.effect: Create an illusion

talents.name: Sign of the king
talents.effect: Give a creature a command

talents.name: Sign of the goat
talents.effect: Summon a spectral goat

talents.name: Sign of the claw
talents.effect: Hold someone or something in place

talents.name: Sign of the child
talents.effect: Change size to become small

talents.name: Sign of the betrayer
talents.effect: Inflict a curse for a short amount of time

talents.name: Sign of the archer
talents.effect: Shoot a magical arrow

talents.name: Sign of the candle
talents.effect: Give an ally +1 resolve

talents.name: Sign of the dragon
talents.effect: Gain +1 armor

talents.name: Sign of the shimmer
talents.effect: Create a small field of invisibility
